Continue the same deepdog premium dark-tech commercial. Match previous last frame continuity: luminous cyan glass issue board in a dark command loft. Sharp 1344x768, photoreal UI.

Continue the same deepdog premium dark-tech commercial from previous control-tower / skill-card moment. Sharp 1344x768 photoreal.

Segment 3 of 3 — payoff and CTA.
[0s-4s] Hybrid team montage: human + agents collaborating around one glowing board, calm confidence.
[4s-8s] Open-source trust beat: local machine and private cloud icons, lock motif, code stays on your infra — no third-party exfil vibe.

Hard cuts, no watermarks, no Chinese characters on the final English slogan card.
